source: owner-supplied production screenshots and live read-only inspection

defects.observed: The Navigator promotion precedes the primary public starting task.
defects.expected: The public story form and core value proposition appear first; Navigator remains a secondary option.
defects.sourceRepair: Move the Navigator promotion immediately after the primary hero.

defects.observed: The primary headline is oversized and consumes most of the viewport.
defects.expected: The headline remains prominent without forcing the task form below the fold.
defects.sourceRepair: Reduce the desktop fluid headline ceiling from 72px to 62px.

defects.expected: Each card link renders one arrow.
defects.sourceRepair: Remove the markup arrow and retain the CSS-generated arrow.

defects.observed: The growth, operations, and compliance promotion appears twice.
defects.expected: One professional promotion with a single clear path.
defects.sourceRepair: Remove the inherited duplicate section while preserving the current unified panel.

defects.observed: The fixed help control can cover lower-page and footer content.
defects.expected: The control moves upward when the current footer is visible.
defects.sourceRepair: Observe both legacy and current footer classes.

defects.observed: A practice query such as copyrights opens a generic homepage with no selected-area context.
defects.expected: The heading, explanatory text, form prompt, and document title visibly reflect the selected legal area.
defects.sourceRepair: Bind the practice query to a focused, privacy-preserving starting experience.

defects.observed: The three working advantages stack as three oversized full-width cards on desktop.
defects.expected: The three advantages display as a scannable three-column desktop comparison and collapse on small screens.
defects.sourceRepair: Restore the missing desktop grid declaration for three-card groups.

defects.observed: After the seven-step tour reaches its final next-step actions, two inherited marketing sections repeat the proposition and create excessive empty space.
defects.expected: The guided story concludes after step 7 and proceeds directly to the legal footer.
defects.sourceRepair: Remove the redundant post-tour difference and Growth Workspace tail.

defects.observed: The desktop tour headline dominates the first viewport and wraps into an unnecessarily tall block.
defects.expected: The tour headline remains prominent while leaving more of the legal-area selector and actions visible.
defects.sourceRepair: Reduce the tour-specific desktop headline ceiling from 64px to 56px.

defects.observed: Core public routes use incompatible legacy header menus and the homepage contains two mobile menu systems.
defects.expected: One public navigation model, one professional navigation model, and one mobile menu control per page.
defects.sourceRepair: Apply shared public and professional headers across core routes and remove the duplicate homepage mobile menu.

defects.observed: Desktop H1 sizes vary from roughly 57px to 82px, page sections use inconsistent vertical rhythm, and high-volume cards consume excessive height.
defects.expected: A restrained common type scale, consistent page width, compact section spacing, and scannable cards.
defects.sourceRepair: Append a shared visual-system overlay for headers, heroes, type, cards, buttons, forms, spacing, and responsive breakpoints.

defects.observed: All 69 legal-area cards and every topic list are expanded, producing a page approximately 20,911px tall.
defects.expected: Search and popular guides first, 12 compact cards initially, all 69 preserved on demand, and topic lists collapsed until requested.
defects.sourceRepair: Move search above the directory, limit popular guides to eight, hide later cards initially, and convert all 69 topic lists to accessible disclosures.

defects.observed: The search control appears after a large group of focused pages and is easy to miss.
defects.expected: Search is the dominant directory action immediately after the hero, with a route for people who do not know the legal category.
defects.sourceRepair: Create a high-contrast search-first band and a direct link to the describe-what-happened starting form.

defects.observed: The page displays 40 card-like blocks across roughly 9,967px, including 21 need categories plus long plan and official-resource sections.
defects.expected: Search and nine common categories first, remaining categories on demand, and optional long tools collapsed.
defects.sourceRepair: Add category search, progressive disclosure for all 21 categories, and collapsed private-plan and official-directory sections.

defects.observed: Multiple inherited promotional sections repeat portfolio and resource-sheet paths after the core directory.
defects.expected: One concise completion band with the three most useful next routes.
defects.sourceRepair: Replace the redundant tail with a private resource sheet, legal-area directory, and professional-directory action set.

remainingReview: owner review of the qualified candidate before production promotion
